findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed the small cooler on the counter storing walking taco toppings was not cold holding foods at 41F or below. The cooler uses frozen ice and was not sufficiently cold holding during the inspection. The foods inside the cooler were shredded lettuce, marble cheese, sour cream, and salsa. The toppings were observed to have internal temperatures between 60-62F. They were put inside the cooler over four fours ago and therefore were voluntarily discarded during the inspection. The inspector and PIC discussed using a time-as-control (TAC) method for the walking tacos topping since they only require a small amount throughout the day. The PIC will be keeping the toppings for four hours and discarding any leftovers after the four hour TAC window ends. The inspector reminded the PIC that they must use a time keeping method to record the time when the food must be discarded.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.
